_readme: Threshold overrides. Edit this file, then: docker compose restart
Anything you do NOT list here keeps the default from
src/commentary_qc/config.py -- which is also where the comment
explaining WHERE EACH NUMBER CAME FROM lives. Read that before
changing one. Every default has a measurement behind it.
A typo is refused at startup rather than silently ignored, so if a
container will not boot after an edit, check `docker compose logs`
for 'unknown Thresholds keys'. A contradiction is refused too: a
clear level on the wrong side of its fire level would clear an alert
The full list of names is in _example below, at their current
defaults. Copy the ones you want into "thresholds" and change them.

_example.comment: Copy from here into "thresholds" above. These ARE the defaults.
_example._loudness_band: what counts as too loud or too quiet, over a minute
_example._peaks: EBU R128 allows -1 dBTP; 3 flat-topped samples is distortion
_example._balance: voice against the crowd bed, in dB
_example._filler: is a holding clip playing rather than a person
_example._speech: how much of a window must be speech to count as talking
_example._escalation: how much worse a firing fault must get to be said again
_example._timing: seconds a fault must hold before FIRE, and before CLEAR
_example._off: rules that do not apply at all, by id
